headline: You deserve mixes you’ll be proud to release.
bio: I'm Ryan Gildea, a versatile audio professional with over 20 years of experience in audio engineering, mixing, and music production. As a musician, I know what it’s like to spend years investing to create your unique sound. My passion for sonic exploration has evolved into a career dedicated to helping cutting-edge, experimental, and psych artists realize their artistic visions.  I bring a unique perspective to my mixes by combining technical precision with artistic creativity.
